sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L227-S01 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Two children discuss homework at a small desk; the protagonist little girl confidently looks at a boy classmate's abstract shape homework as if saying it is correct and does not need changes.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl + boy classmate, clearly different.
Homework paper: abstract circles, squares, and blocks only; no readable text, numbers, equations, or letters.
Style: L058 style reference only, warm pencil-and-watercolor children's textbook illustration.
Avoid: no text, numbers, labels, signs, written marks, logos, watermark.
sentences.imageNotes: 兩個孩子在桌前討論數學作業。主角小女孩看著另一個孩子寫好的圖形題或作業紙，表情很肯定，像是在說不用改。作業紙上不能有可讀文字、數字或算式；可以用抽象圖形、圈圈、方塊來表示作業內容。人物身份：主角小女孩 + 男孩同學或女同學。不可有文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.text: 老師認得所有新生和舊生。
sentences.spokenText: 老師認得所有新生和舊生
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L227-S02 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A visually distinct teacher stands in a classroom or school courtyard in front of many students, warmly recognizing all of them. Some students look new with plain new backpacks and slightly nervous posture; others look familiar and relaxed.
Visual cast: teacher + multiple students. Teacher has short gray-black tied-back hair, rectangular glasses, sage green cardigan, plain top, dark trousers; teacher must not look like protagonist mother.
Style: L058 style reference only, warm watercolor children's school illustration.
Avoid: no text, numbers, name tags, labels, badges, school name, signs, writing on walls, posters with marks, logos, watermark.
sentences.imageNotes: 校園或教室場景，老師站在一群孩子前面，溫和地看著大家。孩子分成新同學和已在學校比較久的學生，但不能用文字標籤區分；可以用新生背著新書包、有點緊張，舊生比較熟悉環境來表現。人物身份：老師 + 多位學生。老師不能像主角媽媽；不可有文字、姓名牌、數字或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L227-S03 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At a normal home doorway during cleaning, protagonist mother and protagonist little girl organize a tidy pile of old things near the door so clean open space inside can receive new things later. Old things include worn boxes, blank-cover books, an old chair, and old toys. A cleaner/recycling worker in plain teal uniform is small in the far background.
Visual cast: protagonist mother and little girl from L154/L162 continuity; cleaner worker distinct from mother and teacher.
Style: L058 style reference only, warm watercolor family-life illustration.
Avoid: no text, numbers, labels, signs, recycling symbols, license plates, readable book covers, logos, watermark.
sentences.imageNotes: 家門口大掃除場景。主角媽媽和主角小女孩把一堆舊東西整理到門口，等待清潔人員或回收車來收走；屋內或旁邊可看到整理出乾淨空間，暗示新的東西才有位置進來。舊東西可以是破盒子、舊書、舊椅子、舊玩具，不要過度髒亂。人物身份：主角媽媽 + 主角小女孩；可有清潔人員在遠處準備收走舊物，但不要有車牌、文字、回收標語、數字或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L227-S04 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl and protagonist father stand safely outside an old-looking house with weathered walls, aged window frames, faded paint, and older roof. Old and worn, not scary or dangerous.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink hair clip and pink jacket; protagonist father with blue shirt/jacket, white top, khaki pants.
Style: L058 style reference only, warm watercolor neighborhood illustration.
Avoid: no door number, house number, signs, text, numbers, labels, posters, license plates, logos, watermark; no horror mood.
sentences.imageNotes: 一棟看起來很老舊的房子，牆面斑駁、屋頂有點舊、窗框老化，但不要危險倒塌或恐怖。主角小女孩和主角爸爸或主角媽媽站在外面看著房子。畫面要表現「房子老舊」；不可有門牌、招牌、文字或數字。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L227-S05 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At a home table, protagonist little girl and protagonist father look at a complicated block-building instruction sheet and a pile of colorful generic interlocking blocks; the girl is unsure but starting to try.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink hair clip and pink jacket; protagonist father with blue shirt/jacket, white top, khaki pants.
Instruction sheet: simple unreadable diagrams, arrows, and vague picture panels only; no text, letters, numbers, logos, or brand marks.
Style: L058 style reference only, warm watercolor family-life illustration.
Avoid: no text, numbers, labels, signs, readable marks, logos, watermark, brand-specific packaging.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角爸爸或哥哥坐在桌前，看著一份很複雜的積木拼裝說明圖和一堆積木零件，主角小女孩有點猶豫但決定開始挑戰。說明圖只能有不可讀的簡單圖案和步驟感，不能有文字、數字、品牌 logo 或標籤。畫面重點是「不知道行不行，但做了就知道」。
